description: The plot illustrates the relationship between layer number and the absolute mean of the hidden state. The x-axis is labeled “Layer” and has a linear scale ranging from 0 to 21, with tick labels at integer values. The y-axis is labeled “Abs Mean” and has a linear scale ranging from 0 to 5, with tick labels at integer values. A dashed blue line, labeled “hidden state mean before gate, avg 0.71”, begins at approximately 0.1 at Layer 0, increases to a value of approximately 0.8 at Layer 10, then increases to approximately 3.8 at Layer 20, and finally reaches approximately 4.2 at Layer 21. A dotted orange line, labeled “hidden state mean after gate, avg 0.05”, begins at approximately 0.04 at Layer 0 and remains relatively constant, fluctuating between approximately 0.04 and 0.1 until Layer 21, where it reaches approximately 0.1. A solid green line, labeled “hidden state mean of baseline, avg 0.04”, begins at approximately 0.04 at Layer 0 and remains relatively constant, fluctuating between approximately 0.04 and 0.08 until Layer 21, where it reaches approximately 0.08.
